verdict.rationale: LanceDB is an embeddable library driven entirely from code, so it runs headlessly by design. The evidence shows programmatic SDK usage in JS, Python and Rust (search, delete and schema changes in code), an embedded deployment in an app, and long-lived API keys for non-interactive auth that work in every SDK. Storage can be local disk or S3-compatible object stores, which suits automated environments. Missing for 10: explicit CI/automation documentation or examples, a headless CLI, and independent hands-on reports of CI usage.
